stonetop.summary: A cursed goatherder turned Boss's enforcer, kept sauced until there's killing to do.

system.concept: A cursed goatherder turned Boss's enforcer, kept sauced until there's killing to do.
system.description: A goatherder from north of @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.VZ3YkXn70E1C7TEO]{Barrier Pass}, with orange irises and too-long fingers — marks of the Howling Curse. She turned up in @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.HesP5wBhjA0l9Ffk]{Gordin's Delve} years back, and one of the Bosses put her to work as an enforcer. They keep her sauced and happy until there's work to be done; then they dry her out, point out the target, and stand well back.
